source_text.slice: REQ-517 slice 2b (route plane, `on` enforcement, persisted shadow evidence), GH #2535, ACs 16 to 22. Tests only; this step changed nothing under lib/ or priv/ (the uncommitted 2b implementation is in the working tree).

task.description: Write the test spec and test code for REQ-517 PR 2b (design sections 4.0-4.8, 5, 6.2, 7): route classification walk and audit errors, Enforce, admin plane under on, stored on, retired nodes, link audit, persisted shadow evidence, deny/metric set agreement (REVIEWER F-1), the off/shadow byte-identity fixture (T-G1). Not run, not committed.

result.summary: TESTS WRITTEN, NOT EXECUTED. 13 new test files (about 166 test cases by a 'test "' count, plus generated per-mode cases), 1 new support module, 1 JSON fixture, 1 spec, 1 config line. No mix process was started: the machine mutex directory C:\Users\tvolo\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\mixlock exists (held by another session) and the brief forbids running the suite on this memory-constrained machine. WHAT WAS VERIFIED WITHOUT MIX: (1) every touched .ex/.exs file parses and is formatter-clean under a standalone Code.format_string! script (line length 98, ecto/ecto_sql exported locals_without_parens), whose fidelity was proven first on five untouched already-formatted files (ok on all five: scope_test.exs, scoped_grants_fixture.ex, tenant_role_scope_grants_test.exs, config/test.exs, route_scope.ex); (2) a static scan found no unused alias, unused defp or unused module attribute in the new files (a stray import of Ecto.Query was found and removed); (3) no helper has a default argument (grep for a double backslash), so the ISS-0069 dead-default check cannot fire; (4) this step changed nothing under lib/ or priv/. T-G1 FIXTURE PROVENANCE (honest): test/fixtures/route_scope/off_shadow_responses.json was NOT captured from a running main. It was DERIVED by reading main's code paths (Response/Error serialisation, the Instances/Tasks/Identity handlers, the Authorize coarse deny, AttachmentLinks) because a git worktree build of origin/main was not feasible (memory, mutex). Its _provenance field says so and gives the regeneration procedure; the replay test compares decoded JSON and content type to it and, independently, the raw body and all headers of off against shadow, asserts the shadow observer really ran, and has a negative control under on. If a request fails identically under BOTH off and shadow the derivation is wrong; if only under shadow, 2b changed an HTTP response. COVERAGE: AC 16 (T-O1..T-O6), 17 (T-C1..T-C9, SEC F-1, F-3), 18 (T-N1 over every admin-plane route), 19 (T-G1..T-G9), 20 (T-I1, T-I2, SEC T-1), 21 (T-K2..T-K6, SEC T-4, T-6, revoke-then-serve direct and full router), 22 (T-H1..T-H10, T-H4b, SEC T-3, migration shape/clone/replay/up-down, REVIEWER F-1 agreement test). Each audit error of RouteScope.audit_routes/2 (:self_service_not_allowed, :unexpected_filter_route, :unknown_permission and the six others) has a seeded-row test; the route-table walk is run against test/fixtures/route_scope/tenant_wide_default_routes.txt and each rule is also shown to fire on the REAL table with one seeded violation. UNVERIFIED BECAUSE NOT RUN (for TEST-RUNNER): the dropped-table end-to-end fail-closed test (assumes Instances GET / reaches the plug and a Postgrex.Error from the lazy grants load); the public-migration scratch-schema test (assumes LIKE public.tenants INCLUDING ALL copies the CHECK by name and that Ecto.Migrator with a prefix runs the constraint commands against the prefixed table); the evidence flush-failure test (a BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger raising must be non-discardable); Supervisor.terminate_child/restart_child of ShadowEvidence (assumes one_for_one); Code.Typespec.fetch_types/1 on Letflow.Api.Scope; the T-N1 handler-gated expected 403 on the four static admin GET routes; the full-router OIDC cases (GET /api/v1/identity/tokens is 200 for a scoped-only admin under off and shadow). A failure in one of these would more likely be a wrong test assumption than an implementation bug; each is isolated in its own test.

implementation_findings: NO IMPLEMENTATION BUG CONFIRMED (nothing was run). Observations a TEST-RUNNER failure could point at: (a) ShadowEvidence.counts_between/3 raises a Postgrex.Error (not an ArgumentError) for a well-formed prefix whose schema does not exist; documented only as ArgumentError for a non-tenant prefix. Low. (b) the Enforce catch clause (exit/throw) is structurally identical to the rescue but unreachable with real inputs; only the raise path is tested.
TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE note: config/test.exs now sets :scope_shadow_flush_interval_ms to 3_600_000 (REVIEWER F-5); the process reads it at every reschedule, so it takes effect at boot.
T-G1 fixture needs verification on the first run (see the provenance paragraph in the summary).
